// Only the columns that exist in the Google Sheet (header row must match these names).
const d = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: {
  received_at: d.receivedAt,
  name: d.name,
  email: d.email,
  phone: d.phone,
  company: d.company,
  service: d.service,
  budget_given: d.budgetGiven,
  message: d.message,
  source: d.source,
  score: d.score,
  category: d.category,
  need: d.need,
  budget_ai: d.budgetAi,
  urgency: d.urgency,
  reason: d.reason,
  auto_replied: d.shouldReply ? 'yes' : 'no',
  input_tokens: d.inputTokens,
  output_tokens: d.outputTokens,
  cost_usd: d.costUsd,
} }];
